question: During which months do retreating monsoons occur in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**October and November**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **October and November** are the months during which **retreating monsoons** occur in India.
 
• The retreating monsoon, also known as the** northeast monsoon**, marks the period when the southwest monsoon winds start to retreat from the Indian subcontinent.
 
• This season is characterized by the withdrawal of monsoon clouds and a decrease in rainfall in most parts of the country, except for the southeastern coast.
 
• During this time, Tamil Nadu and parts of Andhra Pradesh receive significant rainfall due to the northeast monsoon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **southwest monsoon** typically arrives in India in **early June and lasts until September**, bringing heavy rainfall and accounting for most of the annual precipitation.
 
• The **northeast monsoon** is less intense compared to the southwest monsoon and primarily affects the southeastern coast of India.
 
• The retreat of the monsoon is a gradual process, and the transition period can lead to a mix of weather patterns, including occasional thunderstorms and cyclones.
 
• Understanding the monsoon patterns is crucial for agriculture, water resource management, and disaster preparedness in India.
